# Microsoft Rocketbox Military Male 03

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/Microsoft-Rocketbox/tree/master/Assets/Avatars/Professions/Military_Male_03

Animations: https://github.com/microsoft/Microsoft-Rocketbox/tree/master/Assets/Animations

Author: Microsoft / Rocketbox. MIT license, reproduced in LICENSE.md.

Original authored military avatar, not a scan. Converted from non-facial FBX to glTF. Fifteen source geometry groups are regrouped as five material primitives; the original native skeleton hierarchy, including Spine-parented thighs, is preserved. Geometry, bone translations and inverse binds are normalized from centimeters to meters, +Y up, +Z forward; root scale is identity. All ten color/normal source TGA maps are JPEG at at most 1024 pixels. UV Y is flipped for glTF image convention. Native Idle, Walk and Run are retained, absent helper tracks and near-identity scale tracks removed; linear XZ root travel is removed while vertical bob is retained.
